desc:
🌱 Welcome to Farm an Island ! 🌱

🌽 Plant seeds and harvest your crops
💰 Trade your crops at the bank for cash
🏝️ Buy more land and expand as far as you can
🐥 Chickens will help you in your journey!

Can you grow the largest Island Farm? Have fun!

🎮 Experience it on PC, mobile, tablet, or console, with full controller compatibility!

👍 Regular updates! Like the game and join the group!
